name: team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays renders NULL rather than raising on a zero denominator (executed-result parity)
description: Seed team ZZ's only 2023 series as a QB kneel, which the denominator's COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN series_result NOT IN ('QB_KNEEL', 'END_OF_HALF') ...) excludes, so the denominator is 0 over a NON-EMPTY group. Until 2026-08-19 the team recombination emitted a bare sum(num)/sum(den) with no NULLIF, and Postgres raises `division by zero` on that -- a 500 for the whole request, reachable through a season-type param. The answer is NULL: a team that ran no countable series has no conversion rate.
expected_query: with "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN series_result IN ('FIRST_DOWN', 'TOUCHDOWN') THEN CONCAT(nfl_plays.esbid, '_', series_sequence) END) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_numerator, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN series_result NOT IN ('QB_KNEEL', 'END_OF_HALF') THEN CONCAT(nfl_plays.esbid, '_', series_sequence) END) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_denominator from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) group by "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team"), "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats" as materialized (select "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."nfl_team", SUM(t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7.team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_numerator)::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7.team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_denominator), 0) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays from "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7" group by "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."nfl_team"), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_year_teams" as materialized (select "pid", "year", (array_agg(nfl_team ORDER BY game_count DESC, nfl_team ASC))[1] as team from (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team", count(*) as "game_count" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023) group by "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team") as "player_year_team_counts" group by "pid", "year") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays" AS "team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_year_teams" on "player_year_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_year_teams"."year" = 2023 left join "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats" on "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."nfl_team" = "player_year_teams"."team" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
